title: Re-judge the borderline cases
statement: Spend repeat judgments where a verdict sits near its threshold: judge a borderline item again, and break a disagreement with a third run.
example: Overall scores between 0.75 and 0.90 get a second judgment, and a third when the two land in different bands.
detail: Consensus scoring was added on 2026-04-17: an overall score between 0.75 and 0.90 triggers a second judgment, the two are averaged when they fall in the same band, and a third breaks the tie by majority when they don't (commit 9a68759 in `icloud-work/inceptbench`; `icloud-work/inceptbench-main/src/inceptbench/llm/baml_native_evaluator.py`). The variance write-up had traced the remaining flips to borderline pass-or-fail decisions and had ruled multi-run judging out (`docs/EVALUATOR_VARIANCE_FIX.md`, deleted in commit e5be84f).
against: A labelled borderline case still varied between runs with consensus in place (`icloud-work/inceptbench-main/tests/test_evaluator_prompt_rules_962.py`, lines 213-218), and consensus keys on the overall score while most remaining flips were single pass-or-fail metrics (`docs/EVALUATOR_VARIANCE_FIX.md`, lines 584-586).
